title: Meromorphic open-string vertex algebras and twisted modules from Courant algebroids
summary: We construct a sheaf of $\frac{1}{2}\mathbb{Z}$-graded meromorphic open-string vertex algebras from a transitive Courant algebroid $E$ equipped with a generalized metric and a chosen generalized Levi-Civita connection on a smooth manifold. Using a holonomy principle for transitive anchored bundles, we realize these algebras as parallel sections of a tensor algebra bundle built from bosonic-fermionic affinizations of $E$.
